_comment: Hand-maintained, and it has to be. GitHub publishes profile achievements in no
API — not REST, not GraphQL. They exist only in the HTML of the profile page.
So this list cannot refresh itself and goes stale the day another is earned.
Check against github.com/amishasinha18 when you remember to.
Pair Extraordinaire is listed because CallIQ PR #1 was merged with a
co-authored commit; remove it if it has not appeared on the profile.
